issues.detail: Door 1/4/5 light domes are blank white vaults
issues.problem: The door domes are the largest ceiling surfaces in the cabin, and they carry nothing but two flat white light slabs and two bare emissive discs. They have no panel joints, no speaker or emergency light, no PA or attendant fittings, no bezels and no shading. The aisle vault right next to them has joint ribs, a speaker and an emergency light (c120), so the dome reads as a placeholder next to it. Real 777 door-area ceilings are built from several panels with visible joints and carry speakers, emergency lights and recessed light housings.
issues.evidence: r11p/d1 dome patch (500-1100, 120-600): mean 230, std 2.6, flat apart from the downlight. The strip (800,60) = 253 and the downlight (800,472) = 253 are bare white shapes with hard edges and no frame (the ring next to the downlight is 230, the same as the dome). The same blank dome shows in r11v/d4b (400,250) = 229 and r11v/d5b (400,80) = 229
issues.fix: src/07b_ceiling.js door branch (else of zn.door === 2, ~l.316-319): (1) add 2-3 transverse joint ribs across the dome at ~0.6 m pitch, reusing the aisle-vault rib sweep on the DOME profile (3 mm proud, vault tone x0.96); (2) set each lightStrip in a recessed housing: gRBox(0.10, 0.008, len+0.03) in #d9d8d4 2 mm above the strip, and lower the strip to e 0.55 so it reads as a diffuser, not a hole; (3) give the downlights the door-3 bezel (gCyl 0.055 ring in #e3e0da under the 0.045 disc); (4) add one vault speaker + one emergency light per dome on the aisle side (copy the vault fitting at l.246-248 with ceilOutline('door', x))

issues.detail: Door domes clip to white at the door end
issues.problem: The outboard foot of each light dome, where it meets the door lining, is a flat 254 band about 50 px tall at 2x. Part of it is self-emission from the bake, not the lights: eFn returns e 0.5 for |x| > 2.55, the strip next to the door. It reads as a glowing slot, not a ceiling-to-lining corner.
